blocks.text: The Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) allows you to create outbound integrations (i.e., outegrations) that connect the Agentic SecOps Platform to external systems such as work management tools (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow), storage destinations, alert systems (e.g., Slack, email), automation tools, scanners (e.g., Tenable), and other supported third-party services. Where supported, the Agentic SecOps Platform can synchronize updates between the systems. For information on managing existing outegrations, see Managing Outegrations.

To learn more about deployment prerequisites, setup considerations, and planning guidance, see Deploying Outegration Configurations. To identify the available outegrations, see Agentic Security Operations Platform Configurations by Outegration.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Configure.
In the left-side navigation, click Outegrations.
A list of all existing outegrations appears.
Select an outegration from the available tiles. You can also search for an outegration in the search field.
In the outegration setup wizard, configure the setup in the following steps:
Connect: Enter the outegration details. Depending on the outegration type, this step includes selecting an authentication method to communicate with the external system.

Settings: Configure the outegration settings. All outegrations require selecting an entity to create the outegration from. Some types might include additional settings (e.g., work management outegrations allow you to configure the Create Ticket button).
Mapping: Configure the outegration mapping to define how data is exchanged and synchronized between the two systems.
Click Finish to save the outegration.

blocks.text: The new outegration appears on the Outegrations page and becomes available in the relevant Agentic SecOps Platform workflows. If the outegration supports bidirectional synchronization, you might also need to configure the associated webhook by using the applicable vendor-specific guide.
